title: False positive loop detection right after submit

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue describes a valid, actionable bug where false positive loop detection triggers right after submitting a prompt. Reproduction context is provided.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The bug is a localized algorithmic issue in LoopDetectionService chunk overlapping analysis during streaming content check. Fix involves adjusting sliding window / non-overlapping chunk distance validation in packages/core/src/services/loopDetectionService.ts and adding tests in packages/core/src/services/loopDetectionService.test.ts.

summary.problem: False positive loop detection triggers immediately after user submits a prompt when streamed content contains uniform text or spaces.
summary.root_cause: LoopDetectionService analyzes content using a 1-character sliding window over 50-character chunks. Uniform content like consecutive spaces or repeated characters generates 10 overlapping identical chunks within 10 characters of movement, incorrectly satisfying the loop detection criteria.
summary.context: The sliding window step size of 1 causes overlapping chunks to be treated as distinct repeating periods when calculating index distances and period uniqueness.

steps: Modify chunk tracking or distance checks in LoopDetectionService.ts so that chunk index comparisons require non-overlapping offsets (e.g. distance >= CONTENT_CHUNK_SIZE between chunk start positions).
Ensure reset() in LoopDetectionService resets all state properties including inCodeBlock.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Streamed content with repeated spaces or uniform padded characters does not trigger false positive content loop detection, while genuine content loops remain correctly detected.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in loopDetectionService.test.ts passing streaming content with 60+ consecutive spaces or identical characters.
Verify addAndCheck returns count 0 for uniform content.
Run Vitest tests for loopDetectionService.test.ts to ensure all tests pass.
